description_en: Queries the event records of a specified device
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定设备的事件记录
name: QueryDeviceEventData

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or the ID is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果中每页显示的记录数。数量限制：每页最多可显示50条。默认值是10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备所属的产品ProductKey。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name to query.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备名称。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en: The start time of the event records to query. The value is a 13-digit timestamp in milliseconds. Example: 1516538300303
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的事件记录的开始时间。格式为毫秒级的13位时间戳，例如：1516538300303
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the event to query. You can view the event Identifier in the Thing Specification Language (TSL) model of the product to which the device belongs in the console. You can also call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150321.html to view the identifier in the returned TSL information.

If the event PowerOff belongs to a custom (non-default) module testFb, set this parameter to testFb:PowerOff.

If you do not specify this parameter, all event data of the default module and custom modules is queried
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的事件标识符。设备的事件Identifier，可在控制台中设备所属的产品的功能定义中查看；也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150321.html，从返回的物模型信息中查看。

如果是自定义（非默认）模块testFb下事件PowerOff，则参数值为testFb:PowerOff。

不传入此参数时，查询默认模块和自定义模块下的所有事件数据
parameters.name: identifier

parameters.help_en:
The event type to query. Valid values:

info: information.

alert: alerting.

error: error
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的事件类型。取值：

info：信息。

alert：告警。

error：故障
parameters.name: event_type

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order of event records in the response. Valid values:

0 (default): descending order.
1: ascending order.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default value 0 is used and event records are sorted in descending order
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果中事件记录的排序方式，取值：

0（默认）：倒序。
1：正序。

不传入此参数时，使用默认值0，按照倒序进行排序
parameters.name: asc

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the device to query. This is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the device.
<notice> The IotId parameter is the unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. If you specify IotId together with ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。
<notice> IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en: The end time of the event records to query. The value is a 13-digit timestamp in milliseconds. Example: 1516541900303
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的事件记录的结束时间。格式为毫秒级的13位时间戳，例如：1516541900303
parameters.name: end_time

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The event records of the device returned if the call was successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的设备事件记录

NextTime.description_en:
The start time of event records on the next page. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds.

If event records are sorted in descending order (the Asc parameter is set to 0 or not specified), you can use this value as the EndTime parameter for the next query.
If event records are sorted in ascending order (the Asc parameter is set to 1), you can use this value as the StartTime parameter for the next query
NextTime.description_zh:
下一页面中的事件记录的起始时间。毫秒级时间戳。

当事件记录的排序方式为倒序（入参Asc为0或不传入），调用本接口查询下一页事件记录时，该值可作为下次查询的入参EndTime的值。
当事件记录的排序方式为正序（入参Asc为1），调用本接口查询下一页事件记录时，该值可作为下次查询的入参StartTime的值

NextValid.description_en:
Indicates whether the next page of event records exists.

true: The next page exists. The NextTime value is returned. For more information, see the description of NextTime.
false: The next page does not exist
NextValid.description_zh:
是否有下一页事件记录。

true：有，返回NextTime。详细说明，请参见NextTime描述。
false：没有

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
